  <rect x="16" y="12" width="280" height="24" rx="6" fill="#e0f2fe"/>
  <text x="26" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ SPaG SENTENCE STRUCTURE BLUEPRINT</text>
  <text x="306" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">Entry 3 & Level 1 Essential Rules</text>

  <!-- Box 1: MINTS Capital Letters -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="246" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="246" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="139" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">CAPITAL LETTERS: MINTS RULE</text>
  <text x="26" y="92" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">M</text><text x="42" y="92" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Months & Days (Monday, July)</text>
  <text x="26" y="110" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">I</text><text x="42" y="110" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">The pronoun 'I' (Always capitalised)</text>
  <text x="26" y="128" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">N</text><text x="42" y="128" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Names of people & places (Sara, Oxford)</text>
  <text x="26" y="146" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">T</text><text x="42" y="146" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Titles (Dr, Manager, British Council)</text>
  <text x="26" y="164" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">S</text><text x="42" y="164" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Start of every sentence</text>
  <rect x="22" y="178" width="234" height="48" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="28" y="194" font-size="8.5" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Golden Exam Benchmark:</text>
  <text x="28" y="208" font-size="8" fill="#047857">"Every Monday, David and I visit Oxford."</text>
  <text x="28" y="220" font-size="7.5" fill="#047857">✓ All 4 capital rules applied correctly.</text>

  <!-- Box 2: End Punctuation & Commas -->
  <rect x="278" y="46" width="246" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="278" y="46" width="246" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="401" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">PUNCTUATION & COMMAS</text>
  <text x="288" y="92" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Full Stop (.)</text><text x="365" y="92" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Ends a complete thought</text>
  <text x="288" y="110" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Question (?)</text><text x="365" y="110" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Requires an answer</text>
  <text x="288" y="128" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Exclamation (!)</text><text x="365" y="128" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Urgent instruction / alert</text>
  <text x="288" y="146" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Comma (,)</text><text x="365" y="146" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Separates items in a list</text>
  <rect x="284" y="162" width="234" height="64" rx="4" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
  <text x="290" y="178" font-size="8.5" font-weight="700" fill="#9a3412">Comma in Lists Rule:</text>
  <text x="290" y="194" font-size="8" fill="#7c2d12">"Please order paper, pens, folders, and ink."</text>
  <text x="290" y="208" font-size="7.5" font-weight="700" fill="#ea580c">Never join sentences with a comma alone!</text>
  <text x="290" y="220" font-size="7.5" fill="#9a3412">(Avoid comma splice: use 'and' or full stop)</text>
</svg>

context: SPaG Entry Level 3 Mastery, Page 55 • Word Bank 1
issue: Current image (mixed_text_types.jpg) is unrelated stock photography (e.g. dice, food, tools). Grammatical rules require clear typographical visual models.
proposed_concept: Syntax & Punctuation Construction Chart contrasting Correct usage vs Common Failure Mode for Word Bank 1: High-Frequency Days, Months & Seasons.
svg_html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 540 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-width:540px; height:auto; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="536" height="256" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bae6fd" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="18" y="14" width="310" height="26" rx="6" fill="#e0f2fe"/>
  <text x="28" y="32" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ ESTIMATED MEAN: GROUPED FREQUENCY</text>

  <!-- Table Header -->
  <rect x="25" y="52" width="125" height="32" rx="4" fill="#0f766e"/>
  <text x="87" y="72" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">TIME INTERVAL (t)</text>
  <rect x="155" y="52" width="90" height="32" rx="4" fill="#0f766e"/>
  <text x="200" y="72" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">FREQ (f)</text>
  <rect x="250" y="52" width="110" height="32" rx="4" fill="#0f766e"/>
  <text x="305" y="72" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">MIDPOINT (m)</text>
  <rect x="365" y="52" width="150" height="32" rx="4" fill="#115e59"/>
  <text x="440" y="72" font-size="10" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">PRODUCT (f × m)</text>

  <!-- Rows -->
  <rect x="25" y="88" width="125" height="30" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="87" y="108" font-size="11" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">0 < t ≤ 10</text>
  <rect x="155" y="88" width="90" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="200" y="108" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
  <rect x="250" y="88" width="110" height="30" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#ccfbf1"/>
  <text x="305" y="108" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0d9488" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
  <rect x="365" y="88" width="150" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="440" y="108" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">4 × 5 = 20</text>

  <rect x="25" y="122" width="125" height="30" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="87" y="142" font-size="11" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">10 < t ≤ 20</text>
  <rect x="155" y="122" width="90" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="200" y="142" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">12</text>
  <rect x="250" y="122" width="110" height="30" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#ccfbf1"/>
  <text x="305" y="142" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0d9488" text-anchor="middle">15</text>
  <rect x="365" y="122" width="150" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="440" y="142" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">12 × 15 = 180</text>

  <rect x="25" y="156" width="125" height="30" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="87" y="176" font-size="11" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">20 < t ≤ 30</text>
  <rect x="155" y="156" width="90" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="200" y="176" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">8</text>
  <rect x="250" y="156" width="110" height="30" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#ccfbf1"/>
  <text x="305" y="176" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0d9488" text-anchor="middle">25</text>
  <rect x="365" y="156" width="150" height="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e2e8f0"/>
  <text x="440" y="176" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0f172a" text-anchor="middle">8 × 25 = 200</text>

  <!-- Summary Box -->
  <rect x="25" y="196" width="490" height="48" rx="6" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="35" y="215" font-size="10.5" font-weight="700" fill="#166534">Total Frequency (Σf) = 24  •  Total Product (Σfm) = 20 + 180 + 200 = 400</text>
  <text x="35" y="233" font-size="11.5" font-weight="900" fill="#15803d">Estimated Mean = Σfm ÷ Σf = 400 ÷ 24 = 16.67 minutes ✓</text>
</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 540 250" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-width:540px; height:auto; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="536" height="246" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="12" width="300" height="24" rx="6" fill="#e0f2fe"/>
  <text x="26" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ WORDS IN CONTEXT & VOCABULARY</text>
  <text x="326" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">Context Clue Deduction Strategy</text>

  <!-- 3 Strategy Steps -->
  <!-- Step 1 -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="96" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">1. SURROUNDING CLUES</text>
  <text x="24" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">Look Before & After:</text>
  <text x="24" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Read the whole sentence</text>
  <text x="24" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">and adjoining sentences to</text>
  <text x="24" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">grasp the overall sense.</text>
  <rect x="22" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="26" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Exam Tip:</text>
  <text x="26" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#047857">Look for conjunctions</text>
  <text x="26" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#047857">like 'however' (opposite)</text>
  <text x="26" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#047857">or 'also' (similar idea).</text>

  <!-- Step 2 -->
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="270" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">2. WORD MORPHOLOGY</text>

  <text x="326" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">Context Clue Deduction Strategy</text>

  <!-- 3 Strategy Steps -->
  <!-- Step 1 -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="96" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">1. SURROUNDING CLUES</text>
  <text x="24" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">Look Before & After:</text>
  <text x="24" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Read the whole sentence</text>
  <text x="24" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">and adjoining sentences to</text>
  <text x="24" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">grasp the overall sense.</text>
  <rect x="22" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="26" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Exam Tip:</text>
  <text x="26" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#047857">Look for conjunctions</text>
  <text x="26" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#047857">like 'however' (opposite)</text>
  <text x="26" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#047857">or 'also' (similar idea).</text>

  <!-- Step 2 -->
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="270" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">2. WORD MORPHOLOGY</text>
  <text x="198" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Break the Word Apart:</text>
  <text x="198" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Prefix: re- (again), un- (not)</text>
  <text x="198" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Root: the base word meaning</text>
  <text x="198" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Suffix: -ful, -less, -tion</text>
  <rect x="196" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#bfdbfe"/>
  <text x="200" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#1e40af">Example:</text>
  <text x="200" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#1d4ed8">'Inaccessible':</text>
  <text x="200" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#1e3a8a">in- (not) + access (reach)</text>
  <text x="200" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#1e3a8a">+ ible (able to be) = Not able to reach.</text>

  <!-- Step 3 -->
  <rect x="364" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#16a34a"/>
  <text x="444" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">3. SUBSTITUTION TEST</text>
  <text x="372" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#166534">Swap with a Known Word:</text>
  <text x="372" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Replace the tricky word</text>
  <text x="372" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">with your estimated synonym.</text>
  <text x="372" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Does the sentence still work?</text>
  <rect x="370" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#fde68a"/>
  <text x="374" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#92400e">Golden Exam Rule:</text>
  <text x="374" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">Never leave a question blank.</text>
  <text x="374" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">A logical contextual guess</text>
  <text x="374" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">frequently earns the mark!</text>
</svg>

  <text x="288" y="146" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Comma (,)</text><text x="365" y="146" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Separates items in a list</text>

  <!-- Box 1: MINTS Capital Letters -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="246" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="246" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="139" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">CAPITAL LETTERS: MINTS RULE</text>
  <text x="26" y="92" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">M</text><text x="42" y="92" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Months & Days (Monday, July)</text>
  <text x="26" y="110" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">I</text><text x="42" y="110" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">The pronoun 'I' (Always capitalised)</text>
  <text x="26" y="128" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">N</text><text x="42" y="128" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Names of people & places (Sara, Oxford)</text>

  <rect x="22" y="178" width="234" height="48" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="28" y="194" font-size="8.5" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Golden Exam Benchmark:</text>
  <text x="28" y="208" font-size="8" fill="#047857">"Every Monday, David and I visit Oxford."</text>
  <text x="28" y="220" font-size="7.5" fill="#047857">✓ All 4 capital rules applied correctly.</text>

  <!-- Box 2: End Punctuation & Commas -->

  <rect x="278" y="46" width="246" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>

  <text x="288" y="92" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Full Stop (.)</text><text x="365" y="92" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Ends a complete thought</text>
  <text x="288" y="110" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Question (?)</text><text x="365" y="110" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Requires an answer</text>
  <text x="288" y="128" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Exclamation (!)</text><text x="365" y="128" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Urgent instruction / alert</text>
  <text x="288" y="146" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Comma (,)</text><text x="365" y="146" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Separates items in a list</text>
  <rect x="284" y="162" width="234" height="64" rx="4" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
  <text x="290" y="178" font-size="8.5" font-weight="700" fill="#9a3412">Comma in Lists Rule:</text>
  <text x="290" y="194" font-size="8" fill="#7c2d12">"Please order paper, pens, folders, and ink."</text>
  <text x="290" y="208" font-size="7.5" font-weight="700" fill="#ea580c">Never join sentences with a comma alone!</text>
  <text x="290" y="220" font-size="7.5" fill="#9a3412">(Avoid comma splice: use 'and' or full stop)</text>
</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 540 250" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-width:540px; height:auto; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;">

  <text x="26" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ SPaG SENTENCE STRUCTURE BLUEPRINT</text>
  <text x="306" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">Entry 3 & Level 1 Essential Rules</text>

  <!-- Box 1: MINTS Capital Letters -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="246" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="246" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="139" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">CAPITAL LETTERS: MINTS RULE</text>
  <text x="26" y="92" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">M</text><text x="42" y="92" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Months & Days (Monday, July)</text>
  <text x="26" y="110" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">I</text><text x="42" y="110" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">The pronoun 'I' (Always capitalised)</text>
  <text x="26" y="128" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">N</text><text x="42" y="128" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Names of people & places (Sara, Oxford)</text>
  <text x="26" y="146" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">T</text><text x="42" y="146" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Titles (Dr, Manager, British Council)</text>
  <text x="26" y="164" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">S</text><text x="42" y="164" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Start of every sentence</text>
  <rect x="22" y="178" width="234" height="48" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="28" y="194" font-size="8.5" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Golden Exam Benchmark:</text>
  <text x="28" y="208" font-size="8" fill="#047857">"Every Monday, David and I visit Oxford."</text>
  <text x="28" y="220" font-size="7.5" fill="#047857">✓ All 4 capital rules applied correctly.</text>

  <!-- Box 2: End Punctuation & Commas -->
  <rect x="278" y="46" width="246" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="278" y="46" width="246" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="401" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">PUNCTUATION & COMMAS</text>
  <text x="288" y="92" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Full Stop (.)</text><text x="365" y="92" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Ends a complete thought</text>
  <text x="288" y="110" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Question (?)</text><text x="365" y="110" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Requires an answer</text>
  <text x="288" y="128" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Exclamation (!)</text><text x="365" y="128" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Urgent instruction / alert</text>
  <text x="288" y="146" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Comma (,)</text><text x="365" y="146" font-size="9.5" fill="#334155">Separates items in a list</text>
  <rect x="284" y="162" width="234" height="64" rx="4" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
  <text x="290" y="178" font-size="8.5" font-weight="700" fill="#9a3412">Comma in Lists Rule:</text>
  <text x="290" y="194" font-size="8" fill="#7c2d12">"Please order paper, pens, folders, and ink."</text>
  <text x="290" y="208" font-size="7.5" font-weight="700" fill="#ea580c">Never join sentences with a comma alone!</text>
  <text x="290" y="220" font-size="7.5" fill="#9a3412">(Avoid comma splice: use 'and' or full stop)</text>
</svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 540 250" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-width:540px; height:auto; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="536" height="246" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="12" width="300" height="24" rx="6" fill="#e0f2fe"/>
  <text x="26" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ WORDS IN CONTEXT & VOCABULARY</text>
  <text x="326" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">Context Clue Deduction Strategy</text>

  <!-- 3 Strategy Steps -->
  <!-- Step 1 -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="96" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">1. SURROUNDING CLUES</text>
  <text x="24" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">Look Before & After:</text>
  <text x="24" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Read the whole sentence</text>
  <text x="24" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">and adjoining sentences to</text>
  <text x="24" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">grasp the overall sense.</text>
  <rect x="22" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="26" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Exam Tip:</text>
  <text x="26" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#047857">Look for conjunctions</text>
  <text x="26" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#047857">like 'however' (opposite)</text>
  <text x="26" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#047857">or 'also' (similar idea).</text>

  <!-- Step 2 -->
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="270" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">2. WORD MORPHOLOGY</text>
  <text x="198" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Break the Word Apart:</text>
  <text x="198" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Prefix: re- (again), un- (not)</text>
  <text x="198" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Root: the base word meaning</text>
  <text x="198" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Suffix: -ful, -less, -tion</text>
  <rect x="196" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#bfdbfe"/>
  <text x="200" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#1e40af">Example:</text>
  <text x="200" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#1d4ed8">'Inaccessible':</text>
  <text x="200" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#1e3a8a">in- (not) + access (reach)</text>
  <text x="200" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#1e3a8a">+ ible (able to be) = Not able to reach.</text>

  <!-- Step 3 -->
  <rect x="364" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#16a34a"/>
  <text x="444" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">3. SUBSTITUTION TEST</text>
  <text x="372" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#166534">Swap with a Known Word:</text>
  <text x="372" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Replace the tricky word</text>
  <text x="372" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">with your estimated synonym.</text>
  <text x="372" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Does the sentence still work?</text>
  <rect x="370" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#fde68a"/>
  <text x="374" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#92400e">Golden Exam Rule:</text>
  <text x="374" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">Never leave a question blank.</text>
  <text x="374" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">A logical contextual guess</text>
  <text x="374" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">frequently earns the mark!</text>

    <text x="59" y="44" font-size="12" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">6² = 6 × 6 = <tspan font-weight="800" fill="#9333ea">36</tspan></text>

  <g transform="translate(433, 52)">

<svg viewBox="0 0 540 240" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-width:540px; height:auto; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="536" height="236" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#bae6fd" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="18" y="14" width="270" height="26" rx="13" fill="#e0f2fe"/>
  <text x="28" y="32" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ VISUAL MODEL: THE 4 STATISTICAL AVERAGES</text>
  <text x="300" y="32" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a">Data: 4, 6, 6, 7, 9, 10</text>

  <!-- 4 Cards -->
  <!-- Mean -->
  <g transform="translate(20, 52)">
    <rect width="118" height="135" rx="8" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="59" y="24" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#1e3a8a" text-anchor="middle">MEAN</text>
    <text x="59" y="44" font-size="10.5" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Total ÷ Count</text>
    <line x1="15" y1="52" x2="103" y2="52" stroke="#bfdbfe"/>
    <text x="59" y="74" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">4+6+6+7+9+10</text>
    <text x="59" y="92" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">= 42 ÷ 6</text>
    <text x="59" y="120" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">= 7 ✓</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Median -->
  <g transform="translate(148, 52)">
    <rect width="118" height="135" rx="8" fill="#faf5ff" stroke="#a855f7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="59" y="24" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#581c87" text-anchor="middle">MEDIAN</text>
    <text x="59" y="44" font-size="10.5" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Middle in Order</text>
    <line x1="15" y1="52" x2="103" y2="52" stroke="#e9d5ff"/>
    <text x="59" y="74" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">4, 6, [6, 7], 9, 10</text>
    <text x="59" y="92" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">(6 + 7) ÷ 2</text>
    <text x="59" y="120" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#9333ea" text-anchor="middle">= 6.5 ✓</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Mode -->
  <g transform="translate(276, 52)">
    <rect width="118" height="135" rx="8" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="59" y="24" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#14532d" text-anchor="middle">MODE</text>
    <text x="59" y="44" font-size="10.5" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Most Common</text>
    <line x1="15" y1="52" x2="103" y2="52" stroke="#bbf7d0"/>
    <text x="59" y="74" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">6 appears twice</text>
    <text x="59" y="92" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Others once</text>
    <text x="59" y="120" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle">= 6 ✓</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Range -->
  <g transform="translate(404, 52)">
    <rect width="116" height="135" rx="8" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="58" y="24" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#7c2d12" text-anchor="middle">RANGE</text>
    <text x="58" y="44" font-size="10.5" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Highest − Lowest</text>
    <line x1="15" y1="52" x2="101" y2="52" stroke="#fed7aa"/>
    <text x="58" y="74" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Highest = 10</text>
    <text x="58" y="92" font-size="11" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Lowest = 4</text>
    <text x="58" y="120" font-size="18" font-weight="800" fill="#ea580c" text-anchor="middle">= 6 ✓</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="20" y="196" width="500" height="30" rx="6" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1"/>
  <text x="270" y="216" font-size="11.5" font-weight="600" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Remember: Range is a measure of spread/consistency, NOT an average!</text>
</svg>

  <text x="28" y="32" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ VISUAL MODEL: PROBABILITY SCALE</text>
  <text x="280" y="32" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a">Scale from 0 (Impossible) to 1 (Certain)</text>

  <!-- Probability Line -->
  <line x1="50" y1="90" x2="470" y2="90" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Ticks -->
  <line x1="50" y1="78" x2="50" y2="102" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="50" y="122" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#e11d48" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
  <text x="50" y="138" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Impossible</text>

  <line x1="155" y1="82" x2="155" y2="98" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="155" y="122" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">¼ (0.25)</text>
  <text x="155" y="138" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Unlikely</text>

  <line x1="260" y1="78" x2="260" y2="102" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="260" y="122" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">½ (0.5)</text>
  <text x="260" y="138" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">Even Chance</text>

  <line x1="365" y1="82" x2="365" y2="98" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="365" y="122" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">¾ (0.75)</text>
  <text x="365" y="138" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Likely</text>

  <line x1="470" y1="78" x2="470" y2="102" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="470" y="122" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
  <text x="470" y="138" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">Certain</text>

  <!-- Formula Panel -->
  <rect x="25" y="158" width="470" height="52" rx="6" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#86efac" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text x="38" y="180" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#166534">Formula: P(Event) = (Number of Successful Outcomes) ÷ (Total Possible Outcomes)</text>
  <text x="38" y="198" font-size="11.5" fill="#15803d">Example: P(Rolling a 5 on a fair 6-sided die) = ⅙ ≈ 0.167 (16.7%) ✓</text>

  <text x="28" y="32" font-size="12" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ VISUAL MODEL: PROBABILITY SCALE</text>
  <text x="280" y="32" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#0f172a">Scale from 0 (Impossible) to 1 (Certain)</text>

  <!-- Probability Line -->
  <line x1="50" y1="90" x2="470" y2="90" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Ticks -->
  <line x1="50" y1="78" x2="50" y2="102" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="50" y="122" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#e11d48" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
  <text x="50" y="138" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Impossible</text>

  <line x1="155" y1="82" x2="155" y2="98" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="155" y="122" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">¼ (0.25)</text>

  <line x1="260" y1="78" x2="260" y2="102" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="260" y="122" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">½ (0.5)</text>
  <text x="260" y="138" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">Even Chance</text>

  <line x1="365" y1="82" x2="365" y2="98" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="365" y="122" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">¾ (0.75)</text>
  <text x="365" y="138" font-size="11" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Likely</text>

  <line x1="470" y1="78" x2="470" y2="102" stroke="#0f172a" stroke-width="3"/>
  <text x="470" y="122" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle">1</text>

svg_html:
<svg viewBox="0 0 540 250" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-width:540px; height:auto; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;">
  <rect x="2" y="2" width="536" height="246" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="12" width="300" height="24" rx="6" fill="#e0f2fe"/>
  <text x="26" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#0369a1">✎ WORDS IN CONTEXT & VOCABULARY</text>
  <text x="326" y="28" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">Context Clue Deduction Strategy</text>

  <!-- 3 Strategy Steps -->
  <!-- Step 1 -->
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="16" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0284c7"/>
  <text x="96" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">1. SURROUNDING CLUES</text>
  <text x="24" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0369a1">Look Before & After:</text>
  <text x="24" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Read the whole sentence</text>
  <text x="24" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">and adjoining sentences to</text>
  <text x="24" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">grasp the overall sense.</text>
  <rect x="22" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#ecfdf5" stroke="#a7f3d0"/>
  <text x="26" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#065f46">Exam Tip:</text>
  <text x="26" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#047857">Look for conjunctions</text>
  <text x="26" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#047857">like 'however' (opposite)</text>
  <text x="26" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#047857">or 'also' (similar idea).</text>

  <!-- Step 2 -->
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="190" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
  <text x="270" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">2. WORD MORPHOLOGY</text>
  <text x="198" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#0284c7">Break the Word Apart:</text>
  <text x="198" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Prefix: re- (again), un- (not)</text>
  <text x="198" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Root: the base word meaning</text>
  <text x="198" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">• Suffix: -ful, -less, -tion</text>
  <rect x="196" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#bfdbfe"/>
  <text x="200" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#1e40af">Example:</text>
  <text x="200" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#1d4ed8">'Inaccessible':</text>
  <text x="200" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#1e3a8a">in- (not) + access (reach)</text>
  <text x="200" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#1e3a8a">+ ible (able to be) = Not able to reach.</text>

  <!-- Step 3 -->
  <rect x="364" y="46" width="160" height="188" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="46" width="160" height="28" rx="8" fill="#16a34a"/>
  <text x="444" y="65" font-size="11" font-weight="800" fill="#ffffff" text-anchor="middle">3. SUBSTITUTION TEST</text>
  <text x="372" y="92" font-size="9.5" font-weight="700" fill="#166534">Swap with a Known Word:</text>
  <text x="372" y="108" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Replace the tricky word</text>
  <text x="372" y="122" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">with your estimated synonym.</text>
  <text x="372" y="136" font-size="8.5" fill="#334155">Does the sentence still work?</text>
  <rect x="370" y="152" width="148" height="72" rx="4" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#fde68a"/>
  <text x="374" y="168" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#92400e">Golden Exam Rule:</text>
  <text x="374" y="182" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">Never leave a question blank.</text>
  <text x="374" y="196" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">A logical contextual guess</text>
  <text x="374" y="210" font-size="8" fill="#78350f">frequently earns the mark!</text>
</svg>
